result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy limits, and certificates on request, but omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law. It also unnecessarily requires all coverage to continue for one year after the term, which is not part of the playbook and is ill-suited to occurrence-based CGL coverage. The bankruptcy provision remains unchanged, but the insurance language should add statutory workers’ compensation and remove or appropriately limit the post-termination tail.
